blocks.text: An assessment-level attachment stays available for the whole exam (one file only, good for a formulary or reference sheet). A question-level attachment only opens on that question.

blocks.title: 200 MB total per assessment
blocks.text: That ceiling covers every attachment and inline image in the assessment combined.
Resize images to 1920 x 1080 or smaller before uploading. Radiology and histology images are usually what pushes an exam toward the 200 MB ceiling.
